parent: Frozen OKX V1.7 12H full-runner paths with corrected point-in-time 90d admission
hypothesis: Winning positions in the later selected strategy were held much longer than losing positions. As a retrospective hypothesis only, test whether the original V1.7 runner improves when entry waits a complete 24 hours and the source position is still open.
factor: Single variable: replace original V1.7 confirmation-time entry with an entry exactly 24 hours later, conditional on the original runner surviving to that decision time.

wait.anchor: Each event's own original V1.7 12H confirmation and coincident original H1 open; for a control use its own matched control confirmation.
wait.meaning: Require exact H1 opens at anchor + 0..24 hours: 24 contiguous complete hourly waiting bars and the exact delayed-entry H1 open.
wait.native_12h_closes: Require bars opening at anchor and anchor + 12h; their close times are anchor + 12h and the delayed decision at anchor + 24h.
wait.delayed_fill: At the delayed decision timestamp, use the true archived H1 open, coincident with the second completed native 12H close.

eligibility.corrected_original_cohort: Only the independently corrected event_screen rows with eligible_90d=true; controls are retained only when their parent signal is also originally eligible.
eligibility.delayed_90d: Recheck the existing value-based 90d leadership at the delayed entry timestamp, requiring a numeric rank and at least 10 eligible cross-sectional members. Do not substitute the original entry-time rank.
eligibility.survival: Use the frozen original tp_r=0 VectorBT runner exit timestamp and phase. Any original exit before the delayed entry rejects. At an equal timestamp, only an open-phase exit precedes the delayed H1 open; intrabar and close exits occur after the open and remain eligible for a delayed entry.
eligibility.stop_safety: The delayed H1 open must remain strictly on the safe side of the original absolute fixed stop.

execution.native_exit_path: Reuse the exact original V1.7 tp_r=0 path exit timestamp, price, fee rate, reason, and phase. Do not replay the same fixed-stop/EMA exit path.
execution.runner: Original fixed touched-extension stop and confirmed 12H EMA exit; one full position, no target, no partial close.
execution.same_bar_order: Retain the frozen V1.7 stop/EMA callback, including decision-open precedence, intrabar stop/cloud ordering, and source-gap handling.
execution.delayed_entry_account: Recompute fills, fees, cash and hourly marks with the existing VectorBT shared wallet after replacing only the entry clock and open price.

account.notional_cap: Each admitted entry is capped at current account NAV / 9 and additionally at its equal share of available segregated collateral across flat slots, fees included.
account.entry_priority: Low original prior ATR: use the event's source_row_number prior_atr_pct from signals.csv; its matched control inherits the same priority, preserving the existing V1.7 ordering rule.
account.slot_release: Use the existing wallet semantics; a slot released by a position is available only after its exit bar.
account.outputs: Run separate actual, original baseline, and (only after the delayed actual dev gate passes) paired signal/control and 5bp stress accounts.

fees.funding: Not modeled; disclose as a limitation.

selection.selection_rule: No parameter selection; report whether the single delayed-entry arm passes the preregistered development gates. Run matched signal/control and 5bp market-fill stress checks only if it passes.
